Get the Land Use Statistics by Municipality

Source: R/areal-gemeinde.R
arealGemeinde.Rd

Returns the area in hectares by municipality and NOAS04 class from the Swiss land use statistics (Arealstatistik). Use it for settlement, agricultural or forest shares per municipality, and for their change between survey periods.

Usage

arealGemeinde(
  period = NULL,
  nClasses = 17,
  checkSums = TRUE,
  threshold = 0.5,
  cache = TRUE,
  refresh = FALSE
)

Arguments

period

survey period, e.g. "2013/18". The default NULL uses the most recent period; note that a period still in progress covers only part of Switzerland.

nClasses

level of the nomenclature, given by its number of classes: 4, 17, 27 or 72.

checkSums

logical; if TRUE, the class sums are checked (see Details).

threshold

difference in hectares above which checkSums warns.

cache

logical; if TRUE, results are read from and written to the local cache (see cacheList()).

refresh

logical; if TRUE, the source is queried again even if a cached copy exists.

Value

A data.frame in long format with the columns period_x, gem_stand_d, gem_id, noas_c, noas_n, noas_x, area_ha, value_status_c, obs_status_c and flight_year_x. The key is period_x + gem_stand_d + gem_id + noas_c.

Details

The data come from the dataflow CH1.AREA/DF_AREA_NOAS of the BFS SDMX dissemination service (stats.swiss). Three time concepts are kept apart: period_x is the survey period (e.g. "2013/18"), not a publication or boundary year; gem_stand_d is the municipality boundary stand the results are reported on; the year of the aerial photographs a value is based on is kept in flight_year_x where the source delivers it.

Missing, zero and suppressed values are distinguished in value_status_c: "observed" (including true zeros), "suppressed" (confidentiality), "not-applicable" (the value cannot exist) and "missing" (not delivered, including cells absent from the response). The raw SDMX observation status is kept in obs_status_c.

With checkSums = TRUE the sum over the classes of the requested level is compared, per municipality, with the sum over the four main domains; differences above threshold hectares raise a warning. A sum is only checkable if all its values are present: municipalities with a missing or suppressed class or domain are reported as not checkable instead of being compared on incomplete sums. The outcome per municipality is kept in the attribute "sumCheck" (columns gem_id, check_c with "ok", "difference", "not-checkable", and diff_ha).

Results are cached per period, level and region codelist (i.e. municipality stand) of the source, so a new municipality stand of the dataflow is never served from an older cached copy.

See also

noas() for the nomenclature.

Other swiss.statistics: noas(), popGemeinde()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
area <- arealGemeinde(period = "2013/18", nClasses = 17)
head(area)
} # }
